notes.en: Candidate registry for the first release target of 43 entries (4 app-bundled + 39 optional, 9 deep adaptations). The deprecated content-creator redirect is excluded. Every entry stays a candidate until license, package and functional qualification pass; nothing here claims reviewed, packaged, qualified, published or execution-verified status. Pinned commits are the review baseline from docs/UPSTREAM-PINS.json, not a blanket license: each item needs its own per-file license audit before packaging. License blockers are recorded per entry with reasons and required actions; the launch-set count rule (at most three blocked non-required candidates) is a coordinator release decision, not this file.
